name: ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-4.3

usb.notes: Two Type-C ports: native USB (GPIO19/20) and a CH343P UART port. Native USB is muxed with CAN via CH422G EXIO5.

verification.notes: Pins transcribed from the wiki. LCD controller name is inconsistent on the wiki (ST7262 datasheet vs ST7701 in the FAQ).

peripherals.notes: Shared by GT911, CH422G and the external I2C terminal.
EXIO1=TP_RST, EXIO2=backlight, EXIO4=SD_CS, EXIO5=USB/CAN select. LCD reset is also on the expander (pin not given on the wiki).
RGB timings are not on the wiki; copy them from Waveshare's demo (waveshare_rgb_lcd_port.h). Needs PSRAM frame buffers.
Enabled when EXIO5 is high. 120R termination via jumper.
Same GPIOs as CAN; use one or the other. Auto direction.

warnings: Almost every GPIO is used by the RGB panel. Check the wiki pinout image for the few spare pins before adding hardware.
Avoid I2C addresses 0x20-0x27, 0x30-0x3F and 0x5D on the shared bus.
Screen drift/tearing with Wi-Fi on is usually PSRAM bandwidth: enable CONFIG_SPIRAM_FETCH_INSTRUCTIONS / RODATA and use a bounce buffer.
